prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1177; do not mention it.)
text:
Our office represents the individual injured in a sideswipe collision that occurred while your insured was changing lanes. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is now receiving treatment. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, together with a certified copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this loss.

We further ask that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes vehicle data and telematics records, dash camera footage, photographs, witness statements, recorded calls, repair estimates, and the claim file. Destruction or alteration of any such material could prejudice our client's claim.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
